purpose: Select exactly 16 additions that complement the preserved 34-asset Quant V2 Canonical Baseline before any 50-asset replay outcome is observed.

selection_data_separation.rule: The 16 additions must be finalized and committed using only the structural calibration window and non-outcome eligibility evidence before the 50-asset evaluation replay is executed.

hard_eligibility: Not one of the preserved 34 assets
No new proprietary synthetic instrument in the 16 additions
Full reproducible M1 coverage across the structural calibration window
Full reproducible M1 coverage across the evaluation window may be checked for data availability only
Quant V2 applicability contract can resolve the instrument without modifying Quant V2 strategy logic
No duplicate representation of the same underlying risk merely through another quote currency or wrapper unless residual diversification is independently material
No strategy P&L, net_r, net_pnl, win rate, profit factor, ending balance, replay selection status or evaluation-period strategy outcome may be used to rank candidates
characteristics_measured_against_core_34: Mean absolute daily-return correlation to the 34
Maximum absolute daily-return correlation to any individual core asset
Residual variance after projection onto the core-34 return space
Tail co-movement and co-drawdown frequency during stressed core days
Rolling realized-volatility correlation and volatility-of-volatility difference
Asia/London/New York session activity contribution and underrepresented-hour coverage
Governed strategy-family applicability breadth and causal candidate density without outcome scoring
Data integrity, stale-bar rate, gap rate, timestamp continuity and execution-cost proxy quality

joint_selection_rules.method: Minimum-redundancy joint portfolio selection; additions are optimized as a set rather than chosen independently.

diagnostic_only_not_selection_evidence.reason: The 100-asset experiment already showed that blanket expansion can increase absolute return while materially diluting portfolio quality. The 50-asset test must therefore examine deliberate complementarity, not post-hoc winners.

promotion_decision_after_50_replay.requirement: A 50-asset successor must improve economic output without materially degrading edge quality, weekly consistency, drawdown and capital efficiency. Higher ending balance alone is insufficient.
